product.title: Private DMZ Tour

description.text: In Seoul, this private six-hour DMZ day leaves a city hotel for Imjingak Park, Freedom Bridge, Dora Observatory, and the Third Tunnel of Aggression. A private guide and air-conditioned vehicle are listed, with DMZ admission included. The published page notes the DMZ Exhibition Hall among the Freedom Bridge stops. The format suits visitors who want a guided border circuit without joining a large coach. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Seoul, and the itinerary stays on Imjingak, Freedom Bridge, Dora Observatory, and the Third Tunnel that define this outing rather than a palace loop.

highlights: Private six-hour DMZ circuit from Seoul
Dora Observatory views toward North Korea

end.description: Return to your Seoul meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
